text:
alex: Quick question — partner X's nightly ETL is consistently hitting per-key burst caps around 02:00 UTC. They asked for a short-lived top-up we can grant. Thoughts on guardrails?
sam: Can we do ephemeral tokens (ttl 1hr) scoped to routes + rate caps? Console flow to request + approver sounds good. Prefer programmatic approvals we can audit.
megan: Security: must be audited + auto-expire + require service principal approval. No permanent overrides. Also need KMS wrapping for any token secrets.
jamie: Product: partner wants predictable SLAs during that window. They want a UI to request and see history. How do we avoid turning this into a manual ops job?
carlos: Infra POV: propose 'lease' tokens issued by auth service with a small schema. Emit telemetry for lease_id, issued_by, ttl, and granted_rate_caps. We can add an "Active Leases" dashboard.
alex: Proposed UX: partner submits request → system sanity-checks (pattern matches historical daily spike) → if match, auto-grant a 30m lease up to +2x burst; else route to SRE approval. Logs immutable & linkable from console.
megan: Add requirement: request must include justification and contract id; CC security on all grants. Auto-expire only — no silent permanent uplift.
sam: Implementation sketch — minimal JSON we can store and sign by auth service: 
```
{"grant": {
  "key_id": "partner-123",
  "lease_id": "lease-20260310-001",
  "ttl": 3600,
  "rate_cap": {"req_per_min": 5000},
  "scopes": ["/v1/generate"]
}}
```
Need idempotency keys and a revocation endpoint.
jamie: Can we expose in console an "active leases" pane with one-click revoke and a small history view? Product likes that for transparency.
ops-bot: @alex created grant request 1709997777/lease-req-42 (pending); status: pending_approval.
sam: Enforcement order should be: token-level lease override → API-key default caps → org-wide quotas → global circuit-breaker. Runtime needs to annotate decision in trace for debugging.
carlos: Telemetry: emit enforcer.decision (allow|throttle|deny), lease.id, lease.remaining_ttl, and budget.remaining_tokens in tracing/span attributes and the metrics pipeline. Also sample full request headers to S3 for post-mortem (redacted).
megan: Also require metadata: who approved, approval timestamp, reason, and legal contact on the audit record. Without contract id we deny.
alex: Ok I'll prototype an end-to-end flow (request form -> auth service -> runtime hook -> audit event). @sam can you sketch the auth API and event fields? @megan we'll draft the approval policy template.
sam: Will sketch today and send a tiny PR with the API surface. Punting to the weekly infra sync if not finished. :thumbsup:
